fund_objective_or_product_description: The Fund aims to provide a combination of income and capital growth over the medium to long term by investing in a diversified multi-asset portfolio of global equities, bonds, and listed real estate securities, dynamically rebalanced by the Fund Manager.

key_facts.label: Fund Manager
key_facts.value: Meridian Peak Asset Management (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.

key_facts.label: Regulatory Status
key_facts.value: Authorised Scheme under the Securities and Futures Act (Singapore)

who_is_this_for: Investors with a Balanced risk profile (Risk Score 5-6).
Investors seeking a single, professionally rebalanced multi-asset solution.
Investors comfortable with moderate volatility in exchange for growth potential above pure fixed income.
key_risks: Market risk: both equity and bond components can lose value, sometimes simultaneously.
Asset allocation risk: fund performance depends on the Manager's tactical allocation decisions.
Interest rate and credit risk from the fixed income sleeve.
Not capital guaranteed and not a deposit; not covered by SDIC.

fund_objective_or_product_description: The DCI is a short-tenor (typically 1 to 3 months) FX-linked structured deposit denominated in a Base Currency (USD) with an Alternate Currency (AUD).

key_facts.label: Tenor
key_facts.value: 1 month (rollable at maturity at prevailing terms)

key_facts.label: Strike Rate
key_facts.value: Set at inception, typically 1-3% below the prevailing spot rate

key_facts.label: Indicative Enhanced Yield
key_facts.value: Up to 6.5% p.a. (vs. approx. 4.0% p.a. on a plain USD fixed deposit of the same tenor)

key_facts.label: Principal Protection
key_facts.value: Protected only in the currency of settlement; NOT protected against FX conversion loss

key_facts.label: Deposit Insurance
key_facts.value: NOT covered by the Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation (SDIC)

key_facts.label: Regulatory Classification
key_facts.value: Specified Investment Product (SIP) / Complex Product under MAS rules

key_facts.label: Distributor Restriction
key_facts.value: Not offered to Retail Investors without passed CAR/CKA and signed risk acknowledgement

who_is_this_for: Sophisticated investors with a Growth or Aggressive Growth risk profile who hold a tactical view on AUD/USD.
Investors who can accept receiving their principal back in AUD (the weaker currency scenario) without financial hardship.
Investors who do not need guaranteed access to these funds before maturity.
key_risks: FX conversion risk: the investor may receive principal and yield in AUD at a rate worse than the market rate at maturity, crystallising a loss versus the original USD amount.
No early redemption: funds are locked until maturity regardless of the investor's liquidity needs.
Not deposit insured: despite being issued by a bank, the product is not covered by SDIC.
Issuer credit risk: repayment depends on the issuing bank's solvency.
Complexity and rollover risk: investors who roll the DCI repeatedly may not fully appreciate cumulative FX exposure over time.

fund_name: APEX Global Multi-Asset Autocallable Note — Series 7
fund_objective_or_product_description: The Note is a 3-year, non-principal-protected, autocallable structured note linked to the worst-performing of a basket of three underlying assets (a global equity index, a broad commodities index, and a single emerging-market currency pair).

key_facts.label: Tenor
key_facts.value: 3 years (36 months), subject to early autocall

key_facts.label: Underlyings
key_facts.value: Global Equity Index; Broad Commodities Index; USD/IDR exchange rate

key_facts.label: Knock-In Barrier
key_facts.value: 55% of Initial Level (observed only at final valuation)

key_facts.label: Contingent Coupon
key_facts.value: Up to 11.5% p.a., paid only if Coupon Barrier condition is met

key_facts.label: Capital Protection
key_facts.value: NONE — capital is fully at risk below the Knock-In Barrier

key_facts.label: Liquidity / Secondary Market
key_facts.value: No public secondary market; early exit only at Issuer's discretion and may be at a significant discount to invested amount

key_facts.label: Regulatory Classification
key_facts.value: Specified Investment Product (SIP) / Complex Product under MAS rules

key_facts.label: Distributor Restriction
key_facts.value: Not offered to Retail Investors without passed CAR/CKA and signed risk acknowledgement

who_is_this_for: Sophisticated investors (Accredited / Expert / Institutional) with a Growth or Aggressive Growth risk profile (Risk Score 7-10).
Investors who can bear total loss of the invested capital without impact on their essential financial needs.
Investors who do not require liquidity for this portion of capital over the 3-year tenor.
NOT designed for investors seeking capital preservation, income certainty, or short-term liquidity.
key_risks: Capital loss risk: investors may lose part or all of their invested principal; the coupon is not guaranteed.
Issuer credit risk: repayment depends on the Issuer's solvency; the Note is an unsecured obligation of the Issuer.

Market/underlying risk: linked to three different, uncorrelated asset classes (equity, commodities, FX), increasing the probability that at least one underlying breaches its barrier (“worst-of” structure).
Liquidity risk: no public secondary market; early redemption may not be available or may be at a substantial discount.
Complexity risk: the payoff is non-linear and path-dependent; investors may not fully understand the conditions under which capital is at risk.
Currency risk: underlying includes an emerging-market currency pair (USD/IDR), which can be highly volatile.
Concentration risk: not diversified — a single adverse move in any one underlying determines the worst-of outcome.

fund_objective_or_product_description: The Fund aims to provide regular income and modest capital growth by investing in a globally diversified portfolio of investment-grade government and corporate bonds, with a weighted average maturity of approximately 5 to 7 years.

key_facts.label: Fund Manager

key_facts.label: Regulatory Status
key_facts.value: Authorised Scheme under the Securities and Futures Act (Singapore)

key_facts.label: Capital Guarantee
key_facts.value: Not capital guaranteed; underlying bonds are investment-grade (BBB- and above)

who_is_this_for: Investors with a Cautious to Balanced risk profile (Risk Score 3-6).
Investors seeking a regular income stream with lower volatility than equities.
Investors who can accept modest price fluctuation from interest rate movements.
key_risks: Interest rate risk: bond prices fall when interest rates rise; duration of ~5-7 years means moderate sensitivity.
Credit risk: possibility of issuer downgrade or default, though holdings are investment-grade.
Currency risk: unhedged share classes are exposed to USD movements against the investor's base currency.
Not capital guaranteed and not a deposit; not covered by SDIC.

key_facts.value: Authorised Scheme under the Securities and Futures Act (Singapore)

fund_name: Meridian Peak Regular Premium Investment-Linked Policy
fund_objective_or_product_description: The Policy combines life insurance coverage with an investment account. Regular premiums are allocated between insurance and other charges (mortality charge, policy fee, and initial allocation charge) and units purchased in the policyholder's chosen underlying sub-fund(s), selected from the Fund Manager's approved sub-fund menu (equity, bond, or balanced-style sub-funds). The investment value is not guaranteed and depends on the performance of the chosen sub-fund(s) after deduction of all charges.

key_facts.label: Product Provider
key_facts.value: Meridian Peak Life Assurance (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.

key_facts.label: Policy Term
key_facts.value: 20 years, or to age 65, whichever is later (client-selected at inception)

key_facts.label: Premium Structure
key_facts.value: Regular premium, monthly or annual, reviewable

key_facts.label: Death Benefit
key_facts.value: Higher of sum assured or investment account value, less indebtedness

key_facts.label: Initial Allocation Charge
key_facts.value: Up to 60% of premium in policy years 1-2, reducing to 0% by year 6

key_facts.label: Mortality & Policy Charges
key_facts.value: Deducted monthly by cancellation of units; increase with policyholder age

key_facts.label: Surrender Charge
key_facts.value: Up to 90% of account value if surrendered in year 1, reducing to 0% after year 10

key_facts.label: Sub-Fund Choices
key_facts.value: Equity, Bond, and Balanced-style sub-funds managed by Meridian Peak Asset Management

key_facts.label: Guaranteed Maturity / Cash Value
key_facts.value: None — investment value is not guaranteed at any time

key_facts.label: Illustrative Default Sub-Fund Allocation
key_facts.value: Balanced-style sub-fund 60%, Bond-style sub-fund 30%, Equity-style sub-fund 10%

who_is_this_for: Investors who want life insurance protection combined with investment exposure in a single product.
Investors who intend to hold the Policy for its full term (10+ years) and understand early surrender is costly.
Not designed for investors seeking pure investment returns or short-term liquidity — a standalone fund or MMF is likely more cost-efficient for that objective.
key_risks: High early surrender charges: cancelling in the first few years can result in receiving significantly less than premiums paid, potentially close to zero in year 1.
Charges reduce investment returns: mortality and policy charges increase with age and reduce the amount actually invested.
Non-guaranteed values: both the death benefit investment component and any illustrated cash values are not guaranteed.
Underlying sub-fund investment risk: market, credit, and currency risks of the chosen sub-fund(s) apply in full.
Complexity risk: total cost of ownership is harder to compare directly to a standalone fund due to the combination of insurance and investment charges.

fund_objective_or_product_description: The Fund aims to achieve long-term capital growth by investing primarily in equities of companies listed in, or with significant business exposure to, the Asia-Pacific region (excluding Japan). The Fund invests across large- and mid-capitalisation companies and may use derivatives for hedging purposes only.

key_facts.label: Fund Manager

key_facts.label: Regulatory Status
key_facts.value: Authorised Scheme under the Securities and Futures Act (Singapore)

key_facts.label: Capital Guarantee
key_facts.value: Not capital guaranteed; equity market risk applies

who_is_this_for: Investors with a Growth risk profile (Risk Score 6-8).
Investors with a long-term horizon (5+ years) who can tolerate equity market volatility.
Investors seeking regional diversification within Asia-Pacific.
key_risks: Market risk: equity values can fluctuate significantly, including sustained downturns.

fund_name: Private Equity Co-Investment Vehicle — Fund IV
fund_objective_or_product_description: The Vehicle provides investors with co-investment exposure alongside a lead private equity sponsor into a diversified portfolio of unlisted growth-stage and buyout companies across Asia-Pacific. Capital is drawn progressively via capital calls over a 5-year investment period and returned as underlying investments are realised over the fund's life.

key_facts.label: Fund Term
key_facts.value: 10 years from final close, plus up to two 1-year extensions at GP discretion

key_facts.label: Capital Call Mechanism
key_facts.value: Drawn progressively on 10-15 business days' notice; missed calls may incur default penalties, including forfeiture of prior contributions

key_facts.label: Management Fee
key_facts.value: 1.75% p.a. on committed capital during investment period

key_facts.label: Performance Fee (Carry)
key_facts.value: 20% of profits above an 8% p.a. hurdle rate

key_facts.label: Valuation Frequency
key_facts.value: Quarterly, based on GP-estimated fair value (not an independent market price)

key_facts.label: Secondary Market / Liquidity
key_facts.value: None; no right of early redemption or withdrawal

key_facts.label: Regulatory Classification
key_facts.value: Restricted / Complex Product; not offered to Retail Investors

key_facts.label: Illustrative Cash Flow Profile
key_facts.value: Years 1-3: Negative (capital calls exceed distributions); Years 4-7: Mixed to positive; Years 8-10+: Positive

who_is_this_for: Accredited, Expert, or Institutional Investors only.
Investors with a Growth to Aggressive Growth risk profile and a 10+ year horizon.
Investors who do not require liquidity from this portion of their portfolio and can meet future capital calls.
key_risks: Illiquidity risk: capital is locked up for up to 10-12 years with no early exit.
Capital call / default risk: failure to fund a capital call on time can result in penalties, dilution, or forfeiture of the investor's interest.
Valuation risk: quarterly NAVs are GP estimates, not independent market prices, and may not reflect realisable value.
Leverage risk: underlying portfolio companies may themselves be leveraged, amplifying losses in a downturn.
J-curve risk: early years typically show negative net returns before later-stage gains, if any.
Total loss risk: individual portfolio companies, or the fund as a whole, can lose most or all of their value.
